decision.reason: Both 16M projection reductions are below 20%; the sorted projection was slower by 5.51%/1.47% at 4/28 workers. No hypothesis rescue or H1 phase-2 implementation.
decision.scientific_checks: All sorting and cross-worker SPEC comparisons and captured discrete decisions pass. Sorting permutes row order, so exact floating-point output equality was not required.
decision.qualification: Single diagnostic fits; no confidence-bounded performance or Mac release claim.

failed_attempts.reason: The offline cache lacked proptest; the plugin build, binary audit and actual-plugin loader passed. Pinned test dependencies were fetched and focused tests passed in 8034061. No measurement fits were consumed.

trace_decoding.method: Four append-writer pairs concatenate two complete phase payloads, recoverable by their phase= boundaries. Raw captures are unchanged. The decoder verifies all per-fit construction, gather, permutation and RHS counts. Discrete RHS comparisons use indexed fereg lsmr_rhs traces, not concurrent completion order. No fit was repeated.
trace_decoding.clocks: Clock sums include concurrent RHS operations; solver_new contains frame_gather and weight permute_obs_in. These sums are not additive wall-time components.
